title: Design System: Nurik's Academy Operations Platform

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single brass-gold action that advances the current task.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet filled action for useful but non-primary choices.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A transparent bordered action for tertiary choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 24px; border: 1px solid #41453A; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #F4F1E7; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #0D0F0C; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E0BE45; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A substantial dark field with a persistent label and explicit error treatment.
components.css: .ds-input-group { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: min(100%, 420px); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { color: #B4B4AA; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input-field { min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid #292C24; border-radius: 6px; background: #0D0F0C; color: #F4F1E7; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #85877D; } .ds-input-field:hover { border-color: #41453A; } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { border-color: #E0BE45; outline: 2px solid #E0BE45; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #D86B57; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A bounded record or grouped form surface, never a decorative floating tile.

components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 74px 32px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; min-height: 88px; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #292C24; background: #11130F; color: #F4F1E7; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-time { display: grid; gap: 3px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-time strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-ledger-time span { color: #85877D; font-size: 10px; } .ds-ledger-marker { position: relative; display: grid; align-self: stretch; place-items: center; } .ds-ledger-marker::before { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; width: 1px; background: #41453A; content: ""; } .ds-ledger-marker i { z-index: 1; width: 17px; height: 17px; border: 1px solid #E0BE45; border-radius: 999px; background: #11130F; } .ds-ledger-marker i::after { display: block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #E0BE45; content: ""; } .ds-ledger-event { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 4px; } .ds-ledger-event strong { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-ledger-event span { overflow: hidden; color: #B4B4AA; font-size: 14px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ledger-status { color: #E0BE45; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.35px; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-ledger-row { grid-template-columns: 64px 24px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-ledger-event span { font-size: 11px; } }

narrative.overview:
Day Ledger turns academy operations into one continuous working register. Ink-black surfaces hold warm-white information, while brass gold identifies the current destination, the next valid action, and the moments that require deliberate attention. The mood is serious, direct, trustworthy, and pleasant: operational rather than promotional.

Structure comes from tonal bands, hairline rules, aligned columns, and a visible chronology instead of stacked decorative cards. Wide screens use a compact role-aware rail and ledger columns; compact screens move navigation to a five-destination bottom bar and collapse records into a single readable flow. Small functional corners soften controls without making the product feel bubbly.

The login surface shares the same materials, logo, typography, borders, and gold action language. Across every surface, familiar controls, multilingual resilience, exact financial reading, and fast mobile work take precedence over decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black tonal bands create the working canvas.
Brass gold marks active navigation and the single primary action.
Warm-white type and tabular numerals keep records legible.
Hairline rules organize chronology, columns, and grouped records.
Compact radii and restrained shadows keep the interface operational.

rules.name: The Brass Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the current selection, one primary action, or a decisive link; it is never a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Numeric Trust Rule
rules.body: Money, dates, times, and counts always use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Resting work surfaces stay flat; shadow belongs only to a menu, modal, or temporary overlay.

dos: Do use gold for the active navigation marker, the primary action, and short decisive links.
Do organize dense information with one-pixel rules, flat tonal bands, and explicit labels.
Do keep interactive targets at least 48px high and inputs at least 52px high.
Do pair every status color with text and use tabular numerals for dates, times, counts, and UZS.
Do collapse wide ledger columns into a single readable flow on compact screens.
donts: Don't turn operational sections into nested floating card stacks.
Don't use large decorative radii, gradients, texture, heavy blur, or custom-display typography.
Don't fill the active navigation item with a rounded tile; use one gold edge marker.
Don't use shadows on resting content surfaces or color as the only status cue.
Don't introduce a second primary action inside the same task context.
